hero.name: Umoh Ambrose Elijah
hero.intro: I study attacker behavior so I can build better defenses — currently securing documents by day at AIICO Insurance, training for the SOC by night, and building tools under my own brand, Cyberhayde.

about.heading: Defense-minded, by training and by trade
paragraphs: I'm a cybersecurity professional in training and Computer Science student at the **National Open University of Nigeria (NOUN)**, with a strong focus on security operations, threat detection, and defensive cybersecurity.

My path into cybersecurity is driven by analytical curiosity, problem-solving, and a passion for protecting digital environments through proactive monitoring, incident analysis, and network defense strategies. I've built hands-on experience through certifications, cybersecurity simulations, and practical labs covering threat analysis, network security, and defensive technologies.

Currently I serve as an **EDMS Officer at AIICO Insurance PLC**, where I support secure document management, access control, and information governance — work that reinforces my understanding of operational security and data protection in real-world environments.

Beyond the technical side, I'm the author of **Echoes of Wisdom**, a Global Peace Ambassador, and an advocate for using technology as a tool for empowerment, youth inspiration, and positive global impact.
My long-term goal is to grow into a highly skilled SOC Analyst, contributing to threat detection, incident response, and cyber defense at a global scale.

community.heading: Community impact & volunteer work
community.intro: I'm passionate about giving back to the community and creating meaningful change, particularly for young people and underserved communities — through hands-on initiatives that make tangible, on-the-ground contributions.

cards.alt: Distributing stationery to children in an underserved community
cards.title: Sharing Stationery to Children in Underserved Communities
cards.text: Partnered with a local youth initiative to distribute school supplies to children living in underserved areas — reducing barriers to education and supporting students who lacked access to basic learning materials.

ventures.heading: Ventures — Cyberhayde
ventures.intro: Outside my day-to-day work, I run Cyberhayde: an independent software brand helping individuals and small businesses digitize and automate the manual processes slowing them down.

cards.title: Smaxel — Excel Automation Toolkit
cards.text: A 49-tool Windows desktop toolkit built for anyone who lives inside spreadsheets — admin staff, data officers, finance teams, auditors, and small business owners. It handles the cleaning, matching, reformatting, and hunting-through-files work in seconds instead of hours.

cards.title: Church Online Archive
cards.text: A free, cloud-synced records app built for a growing congregation still tracking members, attendance, and visitors on paper and in scattered notebooks. The whole admin team runs it from their phones, members records, attendance trends, visitor and outreach tracking, all in one place.

cards.title: Inventory Tracker
cards.text: An offline-first inventory app built for shops running stock counts from memory or a notebook. Tracks stock and sales straight from the shop counter, and keeps working even without steady internet.

cards.title: Cyberhayde
cards.text: Cyberhayde is the organization behind Smaxel and future releases — built around one idea: manual, repetitive processes (not just paper ones) are a solvable problem. Every product ships with the same security-first instinct I bring to my SOC training: lock it down, document it well, and make it easy for a non-technical person to trust.

cards.title: Password Complexity Checker

cards.title: FortiGate Security Configuration

cards.title: Malware Analysis Lab
cards.text: A FLARE VM environment for malware analysis — dissecting PE malware in Ghidra, applying YARA rules for detection, and studying advanced threats like Stuxnet.
